A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same Collaborative Gym research and contain the complete main text and Appendices A–H. Text comparison and rendered-page inspection support reliable matching of equations, tables, figures, and appendix material despite local layout changes.

before.justification: v5 reports original simulated-agent benchmarks, a human study comprising 150 collaboration trajectories, and a notification-protocol ablation in Section 5. Its appendices also report simulator validation and trajectory analyses.

after.justification: v6 retains the original benchmark, human-study, and ablation outcomes in Tables 3–6, together with the simulator-validation and error-analysis results in the appendices.

M1.justification: The environment API, collaboration acts, notification protocol, user simulator, and ReAct agents with scratchpad and situational planning remain unchanged in Section 3 and Appendices C and E. The Table 2 correction from AccomodationSearch to AccommodationSearch is a spelling edit.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate travel planning, related-work writing, and tabular analysis under simulated and real conditions. The TravelPlanner, arXiv-CS, and DiscoveryBench data coverage, real-user scenarios, and appendix examples are retained.

E2.justification: Table 3 retains the same three agent types powered by GPT-4o, GPT-4-turbo, Claude-3.5-sonnet, and Llama-3.1-70B. The autonomous comparator in Table 4 and turn-taking comparator in Table 6 are also unchanged.

E3.justification: The simulated sample counts, model configurations, temperature zero, 30-step limit, scoring procedures, and real-study sample sizes are unchanged. Appendix F.3 retains the same matched ablation procedure, with turn-taking sessions preceding non-turn-taking sessions.

E4.justification: Both versions retain the notification-protocol ablation, simulator validation, step-limit analysis, initiative examples, and failure-mode analyses in Section 5 and Appendices D and F–H. Moving Table 7 does not add or revise an analysis.

E5.justification: Significance tests and markers, Table 4 confidence intervals, annotation counts, and agreement statistics are unchanged. The simulator-validation binomial test and ablation significance testing are retained, with no added or removed repeated-run or seed information.

E6.justification: Matched benchmark, ablation, validation, and error-analysis results are identical. For example, Table 4 win rates remain 86%, 66%, and 74% for Travel Planning, Related Work, and Tabular Analysis; Table 7 retains 93.0%, 92.0%, and 90.3% for accuracy, consistency, and plausibility.

T1.justification: The POMDP formalization in Section 3.1, Initiative Entropy definition in Equation 1, and worked examples in Appendix F.2 are unchanged. No mathematical assumptions, derivations, or proofs are added or revised.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same framework contributions, dual-control and non-turn-taking novelty claims, collaboration benefits, and claims about persistent agent weaknesses.

C2.justification: Interpretations of delivery rates, task-dependent satisfaction, initiative, and simulator realism are retained. Appendix A preserves the same applicability boundaries and limitations, while Appendix G retains the same attribution of failures to models and agent scaffolding.

D1.justification: The implementation pseudocode, prompts, retrieval and judging settings, server specifications, and participant procedures remain unchanged. The code/data link and MIT-license access information are also retained.

R1.justification: Section 2 shortens the control-mode discussion and omits the detailed τ2-Bench example, but retains the same cited works, Table 1 classifications, and distinction from CowPilot. This is explanatory condensation without a substantive change in research positioning.

P1.justification: v6 condenses one related-work paragraph, adds acknowledgments, changes the running header from Preprint to Published as a conference paper at ICLR 2026, and corrects isolated spelling and grammar errors. The overall narrative and section organization remain intact.

P2.justification: Local text and table placement changes, notably moving Table 7 beside its annotation rubric on page 18 and shifting Tables 4 and 6 upward. Headers and the Figure 19 caption are corrected or updated. All figures and tables are retained without substantial redesign.

improvement.justification: v6 preserves the methods, empirical evidence, statistical support, reproducibility information, and limitations, leaving the paper's substantive quality unchanged. Typo corrections, acknowledgments, and improved Table 7 placement provide small editorial benefits, while the condensed Section 2 loses some explanatory detail. These limited edits produce no meaningful net quality difference.
